# Pharma Careers

Boston University's Metropolitan College offers a variety of programs and resources for students. We are interested in proposing data analytics programs to help students develop skills in Pharma Data Analytics Careers [@pesqueira2024exploring].


```{python}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
#| df-print: paged

import pandas as pd

data = "C:/Users/npadalka/Downloads/Jobs_2026/"
# find parquet files in the directory
import os
parquet_files = [f for f in os.listdir(data) if f.endswith('.parquet')]
data = os.path.join(data, parquet_files[0])
SAMPLE = True
NUM_ROWS =1000
df = pd.read_parquet(data, nrows=NUM_ROWS if SAMPLE else None)
df.to_parquet("outputs/Jobs_2026_sample.parquet", index=False)
df_sample = pd.read_parquet("outputs/Jobs_2026_sample.parquet")
df_sample.head()
```
